name: US–China / Taiwan
value: No blockade or clash; Shenzhen talks 19 Nov
summary: No blockade, clash or new sanctions found by 18 Nov; Trump and Xi meet at APEC in Shenzhen on 19 Nov
state: Trump is due to meet Xi in Shenzhen on 19 Nov on the APEC sidelines, with major deliverables reported as likely to wait for the G20 (SCMP). The White House said on 13 Nov that Trump would raise nuclear arms reduction with Xi and Putin, though officials did not expect an agreement (Reuters via Al-Monitor). No blockade, military clash or severed channel was found as of 18 Nov; Watch holds on continuing PLA activity and export-control disputes.
for_you: Tension over Taiwan affects supply chains for chips and electronics. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: No blockade or clash; Watch kept for PLA activity and trade controls (hysteresis)

sources.title: SCMP — Xi and Trump set APEC talks, major deliverables expected to wait for G20
Al-Monitor (Reuters) — Trump to raise nuclear arms cuts with Putin, Xi on Thursday

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
